name: io.github.Fizzl13/paypal-guard
title: PayPal, guarded
description: PayPal's Agent Toolkit with limits on refunds and the owner's Approve/Deny above them.

environmentVariables.name: PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID of your PayPal REST app (developer.paypal.com)

environmentVariables.name: PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Secret of your PayPal REST app

environmentVariables.name: LIMIT_REFUND
environmentVariables.description: Most per refund without asking you (default 25.00)

environmentVariables.name: FIZZL_AGENT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Approvals in the Fizzl Agent Wallet (Telegram + dashboard): an agent key awk_… from wallet.fizzl.eu

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Approvals through your own Telegram bot

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Your Telegram chat id (approvals go only there)

environmentVariables.name: APPROVAL_IN_CHAT
environmentVariables.description: off to never ask in the chat app (MCP elicitation)

environmentVariables.name: APPROVAL_MINUTES
environmentVariables.description: How long you have to answer (default 10)
